entities.summary: Veronika Erjavec is a Slovenian professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of No. 91, achieved on 16 March 2026 and a best doubles ranking of No. 101, achieved on 15 September 2025. She is currently the No. 1 singles player from Slovenia.
